description:
Check dated official provider guidance before answering a provider error or updating a deployment. Returns candidate changes, documented errors or symptoms, fixes, date meanings and official supporting sources. Filter by provider or redacted error keywords. Available providers: clerk, lovable, nextjs, railway, supabase, vercel.
Limits: guidance only; does not read your repo, connect to providers, run fixes or verify rollout, deployment or live behavior.

provider.description: Optional lowercase provider id. Unsupported ids return the bounded available list.

query.description: Optional redacted error text or public keywords. Remove credentials, private paths and personal data before calling.

name: recent_provider_changes
title: Check recent provider changes
